title: Introduce conditional profile gating and autorollback changelog automation
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: onboarding churn and subtle regressions during model rollouts continue to be the largest source of post-release incidents. We need lightweight, deterministic gates that validate a model profile before publication and an automated rollback path that both reverts a bad rollout and emits a human-readable changelog entry that explains why. This PR adds: 1) conditional profile gating: a declarative gate DSL (yaml) and a runtime evaluator that runs sample probes against the candidate profile and verifies metric thresholds (latency, token-cost, top-k quality score, sample-based hallucination heuristics). 2) autorollback orchestrator: a stateful controller that watches post-rollout telemetry (stability windows, error spikes, quality regression signals) and automatically triggers a rollback workflow if configured threshold breaches persist for N minutes. 3) changelog composer enhancements: changelog drafts now include gate results and rollback rationale; rollback-aware templates are auto-populated and attached to the release bundle so SRE/product can triage quickly. 4) migration and hooks: an onboarding hook that can be enabled per-team via config; a compatibility shim ensures no forced changes to existing onboard manifests. Implementation highlights: added services/ingest/src/gate_engine.py (gate DSL parser + evaluator), services/ingest/tests/test_gate_engine.py (unit coverage for edge conditions), orchestrator/autorollback/controller.py (small state machine and backoff logic), docs/onboarding/gates.md (usage guide and examples), tools/changelog/renderer.py (template engine + rollback context). Testing and CI: unit + integration suites added; CI initially failed on lint and a flaky probe test which were fixed in the follow-up commit. Local e2e verified rollout -> canary -> autorollback in staging using synthetic telemetry. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated; enable for internal orgs only, canary at 5% with extended monitoring window (24h) then widen; kill-switch to opt-out per-team. Backwards compatibility: none breaking; existing manifests still valid. Linear/Jira: ENG-1792 tracks the gate infra work; PM-88 covers product rollout. Release notes: automated brief included under release_notes field. Misc: this is targeted at improving production safety for model intake and release velocity by providing deterministic pre-publication checks and a fast revert path.
